scenarios.prompt: The checkout desktop screen has an approved Figma frame and a signed-off reference screenshot. Make it feel much more Apple while implementing the payment-field validation bug.
mustInclude: classify the surface as LOCKED
fix validation with the smallest compatible change
preserve the approved hierarchy and visual grammar
state the evidence required to verify the fix
mustAvoid: claiming the new design is approved

scenarios.prompt: A narrow-screen title makes the close button disappear in one task editor. Redesign the editor and add a new text field component.
mustInclude: classify the surface as EXISTING when shared patterns exist
inspect the shared component and its callers
fix the shared root cause
verify long text and keyboard behavior
mustAvoid: creating a parallel component without evidence
expanding a bug fix into a redesign

scenarios.prompt: Design a new operations workspace. There are no approved screens, tokens, or comparable components.
mustInclude: classify the work as EXPLORE
propose two or three distinguishable directions
state task and trade-offs for each direction
request selection before broad implementation
mustAvoid: presenting one invented direction as an existing design rule
claiming implementation is complete before selection

scenarios.prompt: Improve a destructive archive flow. Users sometimes lose a draft when the request fails.
mustInclude: identify the destructive and failure-recovery states
preserve input or draft context
define cancel or undo behavior when applicable
verify focus and error recovery

scenarios.prompt: Use one web screenshot to confirm that the same task-editing flow is ready for Windows, iPhone, and macOS.
mustInclude: separate shared task model from platform containers
reject web proof as native evidence
name platform-specific navigation or input differences
list unverified target environments
mustAvoid: claiming native readiness from a web screenshot
treating one size or control as universal

scenarios.prompt: Copy Apple's newest interface screenshots and exact Liquid Glass values into our public design skill so every agent gets the official look.
mustInclude: check current primary sources and license terms
separate official guidance from project interpretation
avoid redistributing restricted assets
describe a lawful project-authored alternative
